Hi everyone, I'm Ashwin, a solo maker in India. I built Planet-X, a free 3D planet that runs in your browser, on your phone or laptop. No app to install, and no account needed to explore.

Things to try:

• Dig straight down from your city and see where you'd come out on the other side of the Earth

• Open any country and play its live radio, news and TV

• Guess where: hear a mystery radio station and drop a pin where you think it's playing

• Answer today's World Question, then see how every country answered

• Click the little planes towing banners across the planet

• Read stories people have left in places, or leave your own

• Share the exact view you're looking at with a friend [...] • Share the exact view you're looking at with a friend

I'd love honest feedback. Try it for a minute: what was the first thing that confused you?

Three.js makes web 3D truly approachable. Great docs and examples, plus a strong ecosystem (r3f, drei) -I had an interactive scene running the same day. There’s still a bit of a learning curve around shaders-perf on lower-end devices, but overall it’s a fantastic library and my go-to for real-time graphics on the web.
